result:
**C round 160 (V-3b transport icons): PASS, with no bugs.** `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. Everything ran in a real Playwright Chromium on `/studio-lab` at 1440×900 and 1280×720, with a fresh context for each session. I did not change any app source.

- **Targeted tests:** the 25 files give 386/386, the same as A, and TS1–TS6 pass. I also read the new TS6 test: it checks what B specified.
- **Source scope:** HEAD is `ad0df77`. The 969 frozen files match and the 10 end hashes equal A's, both at the start and the end of my phase. `git status` shows the 9 granted files plus doc 129, and the protected files are untouched.
- **Diff review:**
  - The component changes are exactly I0–I6, and `strings.ts` changes only the 3 planned values (the `⌫ Deleted …` status line is untouched).
  - No test file lost assertions.
  - Docs 128 and 129 are as specified.
  - There is no inline style, hex colour or arbitrary value.
- **Icons:** each of the 7 buttons has one hidden icon with the right lucide class, size (12, Delete 20, Zoom back 10 px), stroke width, and stroke matching the text colour. Delete turns accent when a range is selected.
  - No old glyph characters remain in the transport.
  - The accessible names are as expected, including the new Delete label and the range hint.
  - Play and Zoom to selection are unchanged.
- **Layout (±1 px limit):** no element was missing or added in any state after the planned key renames.
  - The layout script rounds to 0.5 px and shows Delete's width at −1.0. Comparing the raw boxes against round 159 shows the real change is −0.8 px (x +0.5). All other changes are 0.3 px or less, so the largest real shift is 0.8 px, inside the limit.
- **Surfaces:** Split and Loop show the same rest, hover and pressed fills as round 159 (0.05 / 0.08 / 0.12). They animate colour over 0.18 s, have no transition under reduced motion, and the Loop-on fill survives hover and press.
- **Each button works, at both viewports:**
  - **Play:** real audio output peak 0.1266; Space stops playback.
  - **Back to start:** returns the position to `00:00.000`.
  - **Undo / Redo:** a +6 dB clip gain edit is undone and redone, labelled "Clip Gain".
  - **Split:** cuts the selected clip, 3 clips → 4.
  - **Delete:** removes the selected clip and leaves a gap; focus moves to Undo.
  - **Range delete (extra check):** still announces `⌫ Deleted …`.
  - **Loop:** turns on and shows the brace.
  - **Zoom back:** returns from 275 (or 227) px/s to 40 px/s.
- **Loop hint:** reads exactly `Loop: make a time selection and press Loop (Ctrl+L)` at both viewports.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:** a fresh context with no sign-in opens the `/studio-lab` demo. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio loaded, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. The fake-Bearer 403 check is blocked because the backend is not available in the cloud.
- **Network and errors:** every valid session had no forbidden requests, no Authorization headers, no hydration warnings and no page errors.

The first pair of layout runs hit the known cold-start error on first load (a hydration error plus "Invalid hook call"). The task allows replacing such a run once, so I kept both as marked invalid runs and re-ran them. Every later session was clean.

For B, with no findings opened:
- Zoom back's accessible name is just "Zoom", next to the zoom slider. B already logged this for the polish pass.
- A test's `describe` title still says V-3a.
- A reports that one planned mutation (m160) cannot fail because lucide hides icons by default. I did not re-run the mutations.

Everything is in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-160.md`
- `c-round-160.json`
- `c-round-160/` (tools, measurements, 17 screenshots, checkpoint)
